column1: Very well, Freddy Pharkas. When you are prepared, meet me at the edge of town and together we shall practice what little must be left of your shooting skills, yes.
column2: 好吧，佛萊迪·法卡斯。你準備好了，就到鎮外邊來找我，咱們一起練練你那所剩無幾的槍法，如何。

column1: You were just informed that your prescription-fillin' work was SHODDY. You're not going to hand back the same bad prescription, are you? No, you're not.
column2: 你才剛被告知這帖藥配得亂七八糟。你該不會想把同一帖爛藥原封不動退回去吧？不，你才不會這樣做。

column1: I'm back, Sadie. Sorry for the delay, I just had to check a few things out.
column2: 我回來了，莎蒂。抱歉來遲了，我剛去查了些事情。

column1: Perfectly okay, Freddy, hon. I was just admiring the way you display your goods!
column2: 沒關係啦，佛萊迪，親愛的。我只是在欣賞你展示商品的手藝呢！

column1: Look who's talking!
column2: 你還好意思說！

column1: I'm back, Penelope!
column2: 我回來了，潘妮洛普！

column1: I'm glad, Frederick. I was concerned. Is everything all right?
column2: 太好了，佛萊迪。我剛才還擔心呢。一切都還好嗎？

column1: Everything's fine, now that we're together again.
column2: 一切都好，咱們重聚了就好。

column1: (Blecch! Acccck! Horrrrk!)
column2: （噁！嗚啊！咳嗝！）

column1: Sorry, I just had an errand to run.
column2: 抱歉，我剛去辦點事。

column1: It's about time. Where the hell have you been? I've been worried sick. For all I knew, you were lying dead in a ditch somewhere.
column2: 總算回來了。你到底跑哪去了？我都快擔心死了。搞不好你人已經倒在哪條水溝裡沒氣了呢。

column1: (Geez, no wonder they call her "Mom!")
column2: （天啊，難怪大家都叫她「老媽」！）

column1: Hiya, Smithie! I'm back! Everything okay?
column2: 嗨，史密！我回來了！一切都好嗎？

column1: No, everything's NOT okay, Freddy! M'tushie feels like I sat on a branding iron! Gimmee my Preparation G! I |c2|need|c| my Preparation G, Pharkas!
column2: 不，一點都不好，佛萊迪！我的屁股感覺像被烙鐵燙過一樣！快給我我的G軟膏！我|c2|需要|c|我的G軟膏，法卡斯！

column1: Okay, okay!
column2: 好啦，好啦！

column1: You return!
column2: 你回來啦！

column1: Yep.
column2: 是啊。

column1: It is good to look upon your eternally smiling countenance of face again!
column2: 能再次看見你那張永遠掛著笑容的臉，真是太好了！

column1: Yeah, yeah, I missed you, too.
column2: 是啦是啦，我也想你了。

column1: That Srini! What a guy! He's made a grand and yet peculiarly inviting display of "Ol' Gampy's Fisherman Throat Gullet Descaler Lozenges." He must have heard about that promotional contest being run by the American Society of Salves, Holistic Ointments, Liniments and Emollients Salesmen. (Think about it.)
column2: 那個斯里尼！真有一套！他把「甘皮老船夫牌魚喉去鱗喉片」擺得又氣派又莫名地引人注目。他大概是聽說了「美國藥膏、順勢療法軟膏、擦劑與潤膚劑推銷員協會」在辦促銷比賽。（自己想想這縮寫是什麼。）

column1: Don't touch Srini's handiwork! You never know when one of the roving judges will stop by and check out the display!
column2: 別碰斯里尼的傑作！你永遠不知道巡迴評審什麼時候會突然跑來看這個展示！

column1: Groovy!
column2: 帥呆了！

column1: (GHOULISH VOICE) I'll swallow your soul!
column2: （陰森的聲音）我要吞噬你的靈魂！

column1: This is the cozy little back room of your pharmacy, where you do your heavy thinking. In other words, you don't spend much time here!
column2: 這是你藥局裡溫馨的小後房，你在這裡進行深度思考。換句話說，你其實很少待在這兒！

column1: You open your mouth to say something to it, but words fail you.
column2: 你張嘴想說點什麼，卻一個字也擠不出來。

column1: The pharmacy is falling apart as it is; don't pick at it, you'll just make it worse.
column2: 藥局本來就快散架了；別再摳它，只會讓情況更糟。

column1: That's your laboratory, where you concoct and bottle your formulas.
column2: 那是你的實驗室，你在這裡調配並裝瓶你的配方。

column1: These stairs lead up to your tiny bedroom.
column2: 這道樓梯通往你那間小臥房。

column1: It's a lamp. And a bodaciously ugly one, at that!
column2: 那是一盞燈。而且醜得非常有個性！

column1: The lamp doesn't work. You make a mental note to change the filament. The last piece of cotton thread you used in the bulb only lasted about 45 minutes.
column2: 這盞燈不會亮。你在心裡記下要換燈絲。上次用在燈泡裡的那段棉線，只撐了大概45分鐘。

column1: Some buxom lady's portrait. Notice how the painting seems to follow you around the room? And I don't mean her eyes!
column2: 某位豐滿女士的畫像。你注意到這幅畫好像會在房間裡跟著你轉嗎？我可不是說她的眼睛喔！

column1: Don't move it, it's covering up the remains of a failed experiment in which you tried to cure the common cold by building up a resistance to mucus.
column2: 別動它，它擋著一場失敗實驗的殘跡——你當初想靠培養對鼻涕的抗性來治感冒。

column1: It's a picture of some nearby big rock.
column2: 那是附近一塊大石頭的畫。

column1: Don't move it, it's covering up the remains of a failed experiment in which you attempted to apply a tourniquet to a sucking chest wound.
column2: 別動它，它擋著一場失敗實驗的殘跡——你當初想用止血帶處理胸部穿刺傷。

column1: Your reference book shelf, complete with such top-ten medical reading as:
column2: 你的參考書架，上頭擺著這些十大醫學讀物，像是：

column1: The only book you'll need to finish this game is the Home Medical guide that came packed in the box. Oh, and perhaps a good 10-volume encyclopedia of Western folklore, if you happen to have one.
column2: 要破完這款遊戲，你唯一需要的書就是包裝盒裡附的《居家醫療指南》。喔，如果手邊剛好有一套十冊的西部民俗百科全書，也許也用得上。

column1: It's your hand-hooked rug. One of Madame's hookers handed it to you!
column2: 這是你手工鉤織的地毯。是歐薇莉夫人那邊一位小姐親手鉤給你的！

column1: You peek underneath the rug, but other than a trap door, you see nothing at all. You wisely decide to avoid investigating it until another day. Waitaminnit, a TRAP DOOR? Oh, that's just the way the floorboards are laid. Never mind, there's no trap door there.
column2: 你掀開地毯偷看，除了一道活門之外什麼也沒有。你明智地決定改天再研究這件事。等等，活門？喔，那只是地板拼接的樣子啦。沒事，那裡根本沒有什麼活門。

column1: You keep a pitcher of water in a basin, so you can occasionally wash your face.
column2: 你在臉盆裡放了一壺水，好讓你偶爾洗把臉。

column1: But you just washed your face last February!
column2: 可是你上次洗臉才二月而已耶！

column1: Why, it's your old roll-top desk. What happened to that roll you recently left on top of it? You've must've eaten it!
column2: 哎呀，是你那張老舊的捲蓋書桌。你最近放在上面的那個捲餅跑哪去了？你一定是把它吃掉了吧！

column1: You keep your anatomical models in here. But don't worry, you're not the only one in town with a few skeletons in your closet!
column2: 你把解剖模型放在這裡。別擔心，鎮上「衣櫃裡藏著骷髏」的可不只你一個！

column1: You haven't been able to open this closet since you tested your new formula, Loony Glue, on it several years ago.
column2: 自從幾年前你在這個櫃子上測試新配方「瘋狂膠水」以來，你就再也打不開它了。

column1: This old table is left over from your college days.
column2: 這張舊桌子是你大學時代留下來的。

column1: Leave that table along until FREDDY PHARKAS, INFERIOR DECORATOR.
column2: 別去碰那張桌子，除非哪天出了《佛萊迪·法卡斯：蹩腳裝潢師》。

column1: This chair was left here by the previous owner of the pharmacy, Franklin Pharquat.
column2: 這張椅子是藥局前任老闆富蘭克林·法夸特留下來的。

column1: You rarely use it. It's uncomfortable, unstable, and unattractive.
column2: 你很少用它。它坐起來不舒服、不穩，而且其貌不揚。

column1: It's an old letter, cobwebbed, yellowed and faded.
column2: 這是一封舊信，結著蜘蛛網，又黃又褪色。

column1: You take the letter out of the drawer.
column2: 你把信從抽屜裡拿出來。

column1: ...so I've been thinking about hiring an assistant to help me around the store, clean up, y'know, the usual chores. Think you'd be interested?
column2: ……所以我在想，要不要雇個助手來幫忙顧店、打掃，就那些例行雜事啦。你有興趣嗎？

column1: Oh, I would be highly gratuitous of your bending over to display me such a position! Would you be offering as well a form of payment?
column2: 喔，承蒙您屈尊給我這個職位，我感激不盡！那麼您是否也會提供某種報酬呢？

column1: I'll pay ya 10 cents a day and all the Rustler's Stove chocolates you kin eat.
column2: 我一天付你十分錢，再加上你吃得下多少「牛仔爐灶牌」巧克力都算你的。

column1: That is an agreement!
column2: 一言為定！

column1: Excellent, uh... um... what was your name again?
column2: 太好了，呃……那個……你叫什麼名字來著？

column1: Srini Lalkaka Bagdnish, but you may call me Srini and I will be calling you Freddy, hokay?
column2: 斯里尼·拉卡卡·巴格尼許，不過您可以叫我斯里尼，我也會叫您佛萊迪，好唄？

column1: Hokay. Now let's get cracking, Srini! I'd like you to go out there and create some nice displays for the skin lotions. We may be closed temporarily, but we'll be opening up sooner or later, and we've GOT to be ready!
column2: 好唄。那咱們開工吧，斯里尼！我要你去外面幫皮膚乳液弄些漂亮的展示。咱們現在雖然暫時歇業，但遲早要重新開張，一定得準備好才行！

column1: What it is, Freddy! I will be getting on that now!
column2: 沒問題，佛萊迪！我這就去辦！

column1: Your desktop is closed and locked, just the way you normally keep it.
column2: 你的桌面是關著、鎖著的，一如平常。

column1: The desktop's locked. Damn this crude desktop interface!
column2: 桌面鎖住了。這粗糙的桌面介面真是要命！

column1: That's the wrong key for the roll-top desk.
column2: 這把鑰匙不對，開不了這張捲蓋書桌。

column1: You can't lock or unlock the desk with THAT key!
column2: 你不能用「那把」鑰匙來鎖或解鎖這張書桌！

column1: You lock the desktop. You never know who's gonna sneak in here and try to get their hands in your drawers.
column2: 你把桌面鎖上了。你永遠不知道誰會偷溜進來，想把手伸進你的抽屜裡。

column1: You unlock the desktop.
column2: 你把桌面解鎖了。

column1: Been out in the sun too long? You can't lock the desk until you close it.
column2: 曬太陽曬過頭了嗎？你得先把書桌關上，才能鎖它。

column1: That key doesn't work in the desk.
column2: 這把鑰匙開不了這張書桌。

column1: It's an interesting drawer. You wonder if it's made any famous sketches!
column2: 這是個有趣的抽屜。你不禁納悶它是不是畫過什麼名畫！

column1: As some of the ladies down at Madame's have told you: there isn't anything in those drawers worth looking at!
column2: 就像歐薇莉夫人那邊幾位小姐告訴過你的：那些抽屜裡沒什麼值得看的！

column1: The drawer's locked.
column2: 抽屜鎖著。

column1: You lock the drawer.
column2: 你把抽屜鎖上了。

column1: You unlock the desk drawer.
column2: 你把書桌抽屜解鎖了。

column1: Funny thing about drawers. You can't lock them when they're wide open.
column2: 抽屜這東西挺有意思的。開得大大的時候，你是鎖不了的。

column1: Bismuth Enterosalicyline
column2: 腸溶水楊酸鉍

column1: Potassium Cupri-tartate
column2: 酒石酸鉀銅

column1: Phenolsulphonphthalein
column2: 酚紅

column1: Furachlordone
column2: 弗氯酮

column1: You study Penelope's prescription and prepare to carefully fill it. You wouldn't want to make a mistake with HER medicine.
column2: 你仔細研究潘妮洛普的處方箋，準備小心翼翼地配藥。你可不想在「她的」藥上出差錯。

column1: You study Helen Back's prescription and prepare to carefully fill it.
column2: 你仔細研究海倫·貝克的處方箋，準備小心翼翼地配藥。

column1: As you study Madame Ovaree's prescription, you realize you cannot read it. The writing looks so blurry.
column2: 你研究歐薇莉夫人的處方箋時，發現自己根本看不懂。字跡看起來模糊得很。

column1: You were so clever to use Doc's whisky glass to read Madame Ovaree's prescription. Now you prepare to carefully fill it.
column2: 你真聰明，想到用大夫的威士忌杯來看清歐薇莉夫人的處方箋。現在你準備小心翼翼地配藥。

column1: You study Doc's corrections to Madame Ovaree's prescription and prepare to carefully fill it.
column2: 你研究大夫對歐薇莉夫人處方箋的修正，準備小心翼翼地配藥。

column1: Burner
column2: 加熱器

column1: Waste Receptacle
column2: 廢料桶

column1: Yucch! There's all sorts of discarded chemicals down there.
column2: 噁！下面全是些丟棄的化學藥品。

column1: You drop the contents down the waste receptacle.
column2: 你把裡面的東西倒進廢料桶。

column1: Don't throw that away!
column2: 別把那個丟掉！

column1: You toss it into the waste receptacle.
column2: 你把它扔進廢料桶。

column1: Pepticlymacine Tetrazole
column2: 胃淋四唑

column1: Bismuth Subsalicylate
column2: 次水楊酸鉍

column1: Mercuric Chloride
column2: 氯化汞

column1: Orphenamethihydride
column2: 鄰甲氫化物

column1: Tyloxpolynide
column2: 泰洛西聚醯胺

column1: Nitrabylocynine
column2: 硝巴洛西寧

column1: Medicine Bottles
column2: 藥瓶

column1: Magnesium Sulfate
column2: 硫酸鎂

column1: Prescription Box
column2: 處方箋盒

column1: You only need one prescription box at a time.
column2: 你一次只需要一個處方箋盒。

column1: The prescription box is for finished prescriptions only, not for mixing ingredients.
column2: 處方箋盒只能放配好的藥，不能用來混合原料。

column1: You can't mix items in the prescription box. It's for finished powders only.
column2: 你不能在處方箋盒裡混合東西。它只能放配好的藥粉。

column1: You can't mix powders in with what is already in the prescription box.
column2: 你不能把藥粉和處方箋盒裡已有的東西混在一起。

column1: Phenodol Oxytriglychlorate
column2: 苯酚醇氧三氯化物

column1: Bimethylquinoline
column2: 二甲基奎林

column1: Enteromagneline
column2: 腸鎂靈

column1: Sodium Bicarbonate
column2: 碳酸氫鈉

column1: Corks
column2: 軟木塞

column1: Medicinal Papers
column2: 藥用紙

column1: Matches
column2: 火柴

column1: Mortar & Pestle
column2: 研缽與杵

column1: You carefully label the container "Miss Penelope Primm -- for internal use only." And what internals they are! You dream about them day and night!
column2: 你小心翼翼地在容器上標記「潘妮洛普小姐——僅供內服」。而她的「內在」……你可是日思夜想呢！

column1: You carefully label the container "Mrs. Helen Back -- take three times daily, just before meals."
column2: 你小心翼翼地在容器上標記「海倫·貝克太太——每日三次，飯前服用」。

column1: You carefully label the container "Madame Ovaree."
column2: 你小心翼翼地在容器上標記「歐薇莉夫人」。

column1: Well, that was a fun experiment, but it's not going to help you out of your present mess! You throw it all away as you leave your lab table.
column2: 這實驗是挺有趣的，但沒辦法幫你脫離眼前的困境！你離開實驗桌時把它全丟了。

column1: You carefully label the jar, "Aminophyllic Citrate." Congratulations. You've just created your first batch of "Pharkas' Deflatulizer."
column2: 你小心翼翼地在罐子上標記「檸檬酸胺非林」。恭喜你，你剛做出了第一批「法卡斯消脹劑」。

column1: You carefully label the bottle, "Bisalicylate Antitoxidene." Congratulations. Be careful; this stuff is mighty concentrated.
column2: 你小心翼翼地在瓶子上標記「雙水楊酸抗毒素」。恭喜。小心點，這東西可濃得很。

column1: Your fruitless experimentation completed, you exit your laboratory. Perhaps a chemical solution is uncalled for right now.
column2: 徒勞無功的實驗告一段落，你走出實驗室。或許現在根本不需要什麼化學解法。

column1: You attempt to make something that will cure the horses' flatulence. But until you find a way to "breathe easier," you won't be able to get near enough to those horses to use it! So you toss it away and decide to make a fresh batch after you've got some sort of gas mask.
column2: 你試著調配一種能治馬兒脹氣的藥。但在你想出辦法「好好呼吸」之前，你根本沒辦法靠近那些馬用它！於是你把它丟了，打算等你弄到某種防毒面具之後再重新調一批。

column1: Graduated Cylinder
column2: 量筒

column1: The graduated cylinder is full.
column2: 量筒滿了。

column1: You must empty the graduated cylinder before using it to measure something else.
column2: 你得先把量筒清空，才能用它量別的東西。

column1: The graduated cylinder should only be used for measuring liquids.
column2: 量筒應該只用來量液體。

column1: Solids must either be weighed or scooped with a measuring spoon.
column2: 固體必須用秤重或用量匙舀取。

column1: This bottle of Tyloxpolynide is empty! You never seem to have enough.
column2: 這瓶泰洛西聚醯胺是空的！你手邊好像永遠都不夠用。

column1: This is where you concoct all your potions, pills, powders. It's here that you truly earn the right to call yourself "Freddy Pharkas, Frontier Pharmacist."
column2: 這裡是你調配所有藥水、藥丸、藥粉的地方。也是在這裡，你才真正配得上「邊疆藥師佛萊迪·法卡斯」這個稱號。

column1: Alcohol lamp
column2: 酒精燈

column1: The alcohol lamp feels cool to the touch.
column2: 酒精燈摸起來是涼的。

column1: You quickly lick your fingers and pinch out the alcohol lamp's flame.
column2: 你迅速舔了舔手指，把酒精燈的火苗捏熄。

column1: You fill the alcohol lamp with Dad Gumm's alcoholic elixir.
column2: 你用「老爹岡姆牌」酒精萬靈藥把酒精燈加滿。

column1: You can't heat the medallion directly. You'd burn your hands.
column2: 你不能直接加熱這枚勳章，會燙傷手的。

column1: The silver medallion slowly begins to melt.
column2: 這枚銀勳章開始慢慢融化。

column1: The medallion is nearly completely melted now.
column2: 這枚勳章現在幾乎完全融化了。

column1: You now have a crucible containing molten silver.
column2: 你現在有一個裝著熔融銀的坩堝。

column1: The medallion looks nice beside the cold alcohol lamp.
column2: 這枚勳章擺在冰涼的酒精燈旁邊，看起來挺順眼的。

column1: Excellent idea, but wait until you have somewhere to put the molten silver!
column2: 好主意，不過你得先找個地方放熔融的銀才行！

column1: Allowing only a slight portion of your sample to escape near the alcohol lamp, you notice it turns the flame an unusual color.
column2: 你只讓一小部分樣本靠近酒精燈逸散，發現它把火焰變成了奇怪的顏色。

column1: Whew! What an aroma! You'd better do something about it before everyone leaves town.
column2: 呼！好濃的味道！你最好在大家都逃出鎮之前想想辦法。

column1: The wax in the mold slowly starts to melt.
column2: 模具裡的蠟開始慢慢融化。

column1: The melted wax runs out of the mold and spatters on the work table, resulting in an empty ear-shaped mold! (And a table with a severe case of "waxy build-up!")
column2: 融化的蠟從模具裡流出來，濺得工作桌到處都是，留下一個空的耳朵形模具！（還有一張嚴重「蠟質堆積」的桌子！）

column1: Nothing much happens since the lamp isn't lit.
column2: 燈沒點著，沒什麼反應。

column1: Measure your chemical and place it into a mixing device first, then heat it here.
column2: 先把你的藥劑量好放進混合器具裡，再拿到這裡加熱。

column1: The chemical warms slowly over the alcohol lamp.
column2: 藥劑在酒精燈上慢慢變熱。

column1: Now it's getting pretty hot. Good thing your callouses are thick!
column2: 現在變得相當燙了。還好你的手繭夠厚！

column1: The chemical rapidly reaches a full, rolling boil.
column2: 藥劑很快就沸騰翻滾了起來。

column1: The mortar and pestle is not to be used for heating chemicals.
column2: 研缽與杵不是用來加熱藥劑的。

column1: There's no need to heat up the mixing device if there's nothing inside it. In other words, no preheating necessary!
column2: 混合器具裡什麼都沒有的話，就不必加熱。換句話說，不用預熱！

column1: The lamp is already lit.
column2: 燈已經點著了。

column1: The alcohol lamp is empty. You must first fill it with fuel before you can light it.
column2: 酒精燈是空的。你得先加滿燃料才能點燃它。

column1: The alcohol lamp must be burning before you can use the gaseous spectroscope on it.
column2: 酒精燈必須先點燃，你才能用氣體光譜儀對它進行檢測。

column1: There is nothing inside the crucible to melt.
column2: 坩堝裡沒有東西可以融化。

column1: First, light the alcohol lamp, otherwise you'll wait here a long time for that silver to melt!
column2: 先把酒精燈點燃，不然你在這裡等到天荒地老，那銀子也不會融化！

column1: Enough already with the melting silver! It's melted, it's melted!
column2: 別再融那銀子了！融好了啦，融好了！

column1: Pill machine
column2: 製丸機

column1: The pill machine is empty. You must first place a mixture into the machine before attempting to make pills.
column2: 製丸機是空的。你得先把混合物放進機器裡，才能開始做藥丸。

column1: You can place the pills into a medicine bottle by clicking the bottle on the pills.
column2: 你可以用藥瓶點藥丸，把藥丸裝進藥瓶裡。

column1: To make pills, you need a |c0|mixture|c| which contains at least one solid.
column2: 要做藥丸，你需要一種含有至少一種固體的|c0|混合物|c|。

column1: You must have at least one solid ingredient in a mixture to make pills. It'll be years before "gelcaps" are invented.
column2: 混合物裡至少要有一種固體原料才能做藥丸。「膠囊」這種東西還要好幾十年才會被發明出來呢。

column1: You should use up the current batch of mixture in the pill machine before adding some more.
column2: 你應該先用完製丸機裡現有的那批混合物，再加更多進去。

column1: Different types of pills shouldn't be mixed in the same container!
column2: 不同種類的藥丸不該混裝在同一個容器裡！

column1: The pill machine's empty, so there aren't any pills to collect. You must first put a mixture into the pill machine.
column2: 製丸機是空的，沒有藥丸可以收。你得先把混合物放進製丸機裡。

column1: You can't mix pills in with what's already in this container.
column2: 你不能把藥丸和這個容器裡已有的東西混在一起。

column2: 試管

column2: 水

column2: 藥用紙

column1: The medicinal papers can only hold 5 grams.
column2: 藥用紙最多只能裝5公克。

column2: 軟木塞

column2: 山梨他酸

column2: 利血平林氧化物

column2: 碳酸鈣

column1: Putting the stirring rod on the table will contaminate it. Just use it to stir chemicals in the beaker, then discard it.
column2: 把攪拌棒放在桌上會弄髒它。用它攪拌燒杯裡的藥劑就好，用完就丟掉。

column1: Beaker
column2: 燒杯

column1: It is advisable to measure your ingredients instead of just dumping them together.
column2: 建議你把原料量好，而不是直接倒在一起。

column1: The mortar & pestle is for grinding solids only.
column2: 研缽與杵只能用來研磨固體。

column1: Click the mixture on the container, not vice versa.
column2: 要用混合物去點容器，不是反過來。

column1: Only place one chemical at a time into the mixing device. Thank you!
column2: 混合器具一次只能放一種藥劑喔，謝謝！

column1: This container is for your finished product, not for mixing. Do your mixing in the proper device.
column2: 這個容器是用來裝成品的，不是用來混合的。混合請用專門的器具。

column1: The medicine containers are for finished medications only. Once you've placed something in a container, you must discard it before starting over. Mix chemicals in a mixing device only.
column2: 藥用容器只能放配好的藥。一旦你在容器裡放了東西，就得先丟掉才能重新開始。混合藥劑請只用混合器具。

column1: There's no reason to cork an empty bottle!
column2: 沒理由去塞一個空瓶子的軟木塞吧！

column1: You knock them together, but otherwise accomplish nothing.
column2: 你把它們敲在一起，但也就這樣，沒別的效果。

column1: Balance
column2: 天平

column1: Your finger weighs as much as it did yesterday.
column2: 你的手指跟昨天一樣重。

# NOTE: [重要] 第75行 "Furachlordone" 統一譯名表原訂譯名(U+544B 那個部首為口、右邊夫字的字加氯酮)經 iconv -t BIG5 驗證不合法(僅存在於 Big5-HKSCS,標準 Big5 無此字),違反硬規則4。本行已改譯「弗氯酮」(同音替代字,Big5 合法)以通過驗證,但與統一譯名表不一致,請確認其他批次是否也用到同一字並統一處理(建議修改主譯名表)。
# NOTE: 第101行自創譯名 "Bimethylquinoline" 原擬用的兩個化學慣用字皆非標準 Big5 字(僅 Big5-HKSCS),已改為「二甲基奎林」(Big5 合法)。此行非統一譯名表項目,自行判斷替換,若日後其他批次遇到 quinoline 類化學名,建議統一改用「奎林」。
